description: This file defines a PerformanceReporter class for collecting, processing, and sending web performance metrics and telemetry data, including integration with Web Vitals and desktop app metrics.

classes.name: PerformanceReporter
classes.description: A class responsible for collecting, processing, and reporting web performance metrics and telemetry data.

methods.name: observe
methods.description: Starts observing performance entries and registers Web Vitals handlers.

methods.name: measurePageNavigation
methods.description: Records navigation timing metrics.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Cleans up observers and event listeners (for testing).

methods.name: handleObservations
methods.description: Processes performance entries observed.

methods.name: handleMeasure
methods.description: Handles performance measure entries.

methods.name: handleMark
methods.description: Handles performance mark entries.

methods.name: handleLongTask
methods.description: Handles long task entries.

methods.name: incrementCounter
methods.description: Increments a counter for a given metric name.

methods.name: handleWebVital
methods.description: Processes Web Vitals metrics.

methods.name: handleReportTimeout
methods.description: Triggers report sending at scheduled intervals.

methods.name: handleVisibilityChange
methods.description: Sends report when page becomes hidden.

methods.name: nextTimeout
methods.description: Calculates a randomized timeout for next report.

methods.name: canReportMetrics
methods.description: Checks if metrics can be reported based on config and user state.

methods.name: maybeSendReport
methods.description: Generates and sends a report if conditions are met.

methods.name: generateReport
methods.description: Creates a performance report object.

methods.name: getReportStartEnd
methods.description: Calculates start and end timestamps for the report.

methods.name: countersToMeasures
methods.description: Converts counters to measure objects.

methods.name: sendReport
methods.description: Sends the report via beacon or fetch.

methods.name: sendBeacon
methods.description: Attempts to send data using navigator.sendBeacon.

methods.name: collectDesktopAppMetrics
methods.description: Collects desktop app CPU and memory metrics.
